reviewSummary.finding: The constrained-tablet repair preserves the existing world-first morphology-atlas cloud presentation and all frozen resource ceilings while changing only interaction scheduling in the existing single-context tablet runtime. Raw pointer and wheel events no longer directly force full world/cloud/celestial composites; camera intent is coalesced through requestAnimationFrame, with at most one world-plus-cloud composite per active interaction frame, and celestial composition is deferred until interaction settles. Phone/desktop, renderer, cloud shader, morphology atlas, camera semantics, loader, audio, geography, and protected 24057 bytes remain unchanged. Structural anchor continuity passes; physical tablet session stability and owner-visible acceptance remain pending and are not inferred by this receipt.
